evidence: CDIAL 6676 *dviḥsara explicitly gives Hindi dūsrā, Nepali dosro, Bengali dosar/dosrā and Oriya dosara another/second. Selected dosar/dūsar responses elicited different extend the directly attested another sense; repeated forms are distributive.
